Title: OnTheEdge, Jyhad Tourneys and so on....

Messages.Author: S. Dembo
Messages.Body:
Ok, a bunch of things here.  First of all, a few questions regarding 
rules clarifications for Jyhad.
1) Gideon Fontain calls a vote.  He plays as a modifier, Disarming 
Precense at the superior version.  My question is, can vampires that were 
tapped before the vote cast their votes in or not?  The card says "All 
vampires casting votes are tapped."  Well?
2) Can Aneke block Dawn Operation?  I heard it was ruled that Eagle's 
Sight could, and anneke appears to have the same ability.
 
Jyahd Tourney's and such:  Has anyone played in one yet?  I"m going to 
this weekend and in a few monthes, I'm going to be running one.  I'm just 
wondering how people ran them, whether they had a "restricted" list of 
sorts or what...  I fully intened to say at the least, no more than four 
of any single card, but has anyone gone any farther than that?
 
On The Edge:  First of all, are there booster packs for the game yet?   I 
bought a few starters and so far I like it alot.  I especially like the 
fact taht so far this is the only game where you actually get to choose 
WHICH chractor yer attacking :)  I like that.  Ialso like the way the 
structure you choose really plays a big factor in the style of game you 
play.  Question, how do you win?  I know you have to try to amass 24 
IP's, but how do you get IP's, are the cummulative?   Can they go 
negative?  etc.etc.  I didn't get that.  Also, if there's a bullet by the 
cost, does that mean it has to be PLAYED by/on someone with that trait or 
does it mean that you just have to have that trait in play somewhere to 
play the card....?  
 
As to distribution, a friend of mine got one of those all charactor decks 
too...  some 55 charactors and some whammy's or somthing.  I wondered 
about that, so I looked on the side of the starter box.  Lo and behold, 
guess who distributed it???  Carta Mundi!  Surprised?  Yup, Don't expect 
great distribution, because its the same people who brought you the 
bequtiful distribution of Legends, AQ, Jyhad, RV etc.etc.etc.
Anyway, that's all for now, if you know the answers to any of the 
quesetions , either post 'em or mail 'em to me....
Peace Love and Anarchy
steve
Lyfe Smyth

On The Edge:  First of all, are there booster packs for the game yet?

Yes, they arrived here with the starters (10 cards - 3 uncommons, 1 rare
- rarity not guaranteed of course).

   I 
>bought a few starters and so far I like it alot.  I especially like the 
>fact taht so far this is the only game where you actually get to choose 
>WHICH chractor yer attacking :)  I like that.  Ialso like the way the 
>structure you choose really plays a big factor in the style of game you 
>play.  Question, how do you win?  I know you have to try to amass 24 
>IP's, but how do you get IP's, are the cummulative?   Can they go 
>negative?  etc.etc.  I didn't get that.

You get influence by spending Pull - (N.B. none of the Resources I've seen
can be used for influence) - see bottom of p. 25 of the rules.  Yes, it is
cumulative.  I don't know if Influence can go negative, I'd have guessed 
not (it's pretty unlikely anyway).

  Also, if there's a bullet by the 
>cost, does that mean it has to be PLAYED by/on someone with that trait or 
>does it mean that you just have to have that trait in play somewhere to 
>play the card....?  

You just have to have *one* of the traits on a Character or Resource in play
(p 12).

Paul K.
